main_text.p: alios, idem cum illis sentientes; (quod tamen hîc nondum constat:) eò quòd de illorum errore moniti non sint, nec moneri per tempus longè prius potuerint: alia tamen est hodiernorum nostrorum ratio; qui moniti, pertinaci-ter resistere pergunt veritati, & pacem publicam turbare. Itaque diversa lon-gè est causa; nec [illegible, ~12 letters]: si, excu-satis Patribus, & qui hodie per ignorantiam idem sentiunt: ut olim Pelagius, Cælestinus, & Massilienses; ita hodie Remonstrantes, tanquam haeretici, da-mnentur eo modo, quo vult Christus. Matth.18,v.17. & Paulus, ad Tit.3.v.10. à fratribus: à Magistratu item alio modo, qui ipsum decet.

Restant tria Remonstrantium Enuntia-ta, quibus patronos putat Grotius reperi-ri posse, non modò in illâ primâ antiquitate; sed ipsum quoque Augustinum, qualis erat etiam cùm Pelagij dogmata oppugnaret: ea-demque ab haeresi liberare conatur, per calorem contentionis, plerumque longius, quàm par est, abripientem. cùm potuisset etiam per

page.notes: The Greek word after "nec" is printed in Greek letters and is too blurred to read with confidence, so it is marked illegible. The page number is printed with a small degree-like mark after 47; it is transcribed as 47°. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page's text and is excluded. No running head, signature or margin note is printed on this page. The catchword "per" stands at the right below the last line.
